# Beyond®

> Creative Growth Agency — "Tomorrow's brands, today."™
> Website: https://beyondbasics.studio
> Contact: hello@beyondbasics.studio
> New business: hello@beyondbasics.studio
> Press: press@beyondbasics.studio
> Careers: jobs@beyondbasics.studio
> Founded: 2020
> Founding Partner: Guillaume Hamon (linkedin.com/in/guillaumehamon/)

Beyond® is a creative growth agency that partners with ambitious companies to transform them into category leaders. We combine brand strategy, identity design, web design and development, motion, 3D, and WebGL into end-to-end creative engagements. Our portfolio spans fintech, Web3, SaaS, health, consumer, and lifestyle brands across three continents.

---

## What We Do

Beyond sits at the intersection of strategy, design, and technology. We are not a traditional agency — we are a deliberately lean collective of seasoned senior creatives, strategists, growth marketers, and technologists assembled around one founding partner. Clients get direct access to decision-makers with no account layers, no briefing-chains, and no junior work.

**Awards:** 29× Awwwards (Site of the Day, Developer Award, Mobile Excellence) · 19× The FWA · 34× CSS Design Awards · 2× Webby Awards · LogoLounge Trends Feature

---

## Services

### 1. Brand Strategy
Clarity before creation. The thinking that makes everything else work.
- Positioning and differentiation
- Naming and brand architecture
- Messaging framework and tone of voice
- Audience and market research
- Competitive landscape analysis
- Brand narrative and storytelling
URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/services/brand-strategy

### 2. Brand Identity
Identity that earns attention. A visual system built to outlast trends.
- Logo design and mark development
- Visual identity system
- Typography system and type selection
- Colour system and palette
- Motion identity and animation language
- Iconography and illustration style
- Brand guidelines and documentation
URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/services/brand-identity

### 3. Digital Experience
Websites that convert and inspire — award-winning interactive builds.
- Web design (UI/UX)
- Web development (React, Next.js, GSAP, Three.js, WebGL)
- E-commerce design and UX
- Design systems for product teams
- 3D visualisation and interactive 3D
- Motion and scroll-driven animation
URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/services/digital-experience

### 4. Growth Marketing
Brand-led growth that compounds. Performance with a creative edge.
- Growth strategy and channel planning
- Paid creative (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok)
- SEO and content strategy
- Email and lifecycle marketing
- Landing page design and conversion rate optimisation
URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/services/growth-marketing

### 5. Content & Creative
Content that earns its place. Art-directed, not produced.
- Brand photography direction
- Video production and direction
- Copywriting and editorial
- CGI and 3D product visualisation
- Social content systems
URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/services/content-creative

## Engagement Models

### Sprint — Focused Transformation
A scoped engagement with a fixed price, fixed deliverables, and fixed timeline. Ideal for rebrands, website launches, campaign sprints, or product redesigns. We define the objective, assemble the right team, and execute with full accountability.
URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/pricing

### Partnership — Embedded Creative Partner
An ongoing monthly retainer. Beyond becomes an embedded extension of your team, covering brand evolution, campaign work, product design, and continuous digital execution. 30 days' notice to cancel. No lock-in periods beyond the notice window.
URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/pricing

---

## Our Process

1. **Discovery** — Deep-dive into your brand, market, audience, and competitive set to uncover the strategic opportunity.
2. **Strategy** — Define positioning, naming, messaging, and creative direction — the north star for everything that follows.
3. **Design** — Craft the visual identity, web experience, and brand system that expresses your strategy with precision.
4. **Build** — Develop and engineer the digital experience to production-ready quality with pixel-perfect execution.
5. **Launch** — Deploy, activate, and support your brand through go-to-market and the critical first 90 days.
URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/process

## Journal (8 Articles)

Long-form thinking on brand strategy, design craft, and creative growth.

1. **How We Rebranded a Fintech in 90 Days Without Cutting Corners** — The Tensor project: hypothesis-driven design, decision-making frameworks, and a rebrand completed at sprint pace without sacrificing depth. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/journal/tensor-brand-90-days

2. **Brand-Led Growth: Why Your Best Marketing Asset Is Your Brand** — The compounding return on brand investment: how strong brand identity reduces CAC, increases LTV, and turns customers into advocates. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/journal/brand-led-growth

3. **What Oura Got Right: The Case for Radical Simplicity in Brand** — How restraint became Oura's most powerful strategic tool — and what other brands can learn from their approach to visual identity. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/journal/oura-simplicity-strategy

4. **The Art of Naming: How Great Brands Find Their Word** — The full naming process: from strategic territory to linguistic testing, trademark screening, and stakeholder alignment. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/journal/art-of-naming

5. **What Made Moxion's Brand Work for Sustainability** — How Moxion Power built a brand that communicated innovation and environmental commitment simultaneously — without greenwashing. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/journal/moxion-sustainable-brand

6. **What It Takes to Build an Award-Worthy Digital Experience** — The technical and creative decisions behind Awwwards-winning interactive websites: WebGL, GSAP, performance budgets, and creative direction. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/journal/award-worthy-digital-experience

7. **Photography as Brand Language: Why Art Direction Matters More Than Budget** — How brand photography direction — not production budget — determines whether images build brand equity or dilute it. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/journal/photography-as-brand-language

8. **Pre-Launch Brand Building: How to Win Before You Ship** — The brand strategy playbook for pre-launch companies: building recognition, trust, and demand before a single product is available. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/journal/pre-launch-brand-building

## Brand & Design Glossary (25 Terms)

Authoritative definitions written by the Beyond team:

- **Brand Identity** — The full system of visual elements that make a brand instantly recognisable: logo, typography, colour, motion, and the rules governing how they work together. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/brand-identity
- **Brand Strategy** — The foundational thinking defining what a brand stands for, who it's for, how it differs from competitors, and how it communicates across every touchpoint. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/brand-strategy
- **Visual Identity** — The collection of graphic elements (mark, typography, colour, pattern, imagery, motion) that translate brand strategy into a visible, consistent system. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/visual-identity
- **Logo Design** — The creation of a distinctive mark — wordmark, symbol, or combination — that anchors a brand's visual identity and functions across all scales and contexts. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/logo-design
- **Design System** — A shared library of reusable components, tokens, and usage guidelines that enables teams to build consistent interfaces at scale. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/design-system
- **Brand Guidelines** — The rulebook documenting how all brand elements (logo, colour, type, voice, imagery) should and should not be used across every medium. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/brand-guidelines
- **Typography System** — A structured hierarchy of typeface choices and usage rules that establishes visual rhythm, readability, and brand personality across all communications. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/typography-system
- **Colour System** — A defined palette with primary, secondary, and extended colours, including usage rules for digital, print, and environmental contexts. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/color-system
- **Motion Identity** — The system of animation principles, timing, and transitions that give a brand a consistent, recognisable feeling when elements move. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/motion-identity
- **Verbal Identity** — The brand's distinctive voice, tone, vocabulary, and messaging framework — the words-layer of brand identity. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/verbal-identity
- **Brand Architecture** — The structural framework organising a company's portfolio of brands, sub-brands, and products into a coherent, navigable system. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/brand-architecture
- **Brand Positioning** — The deliberate act of claiming a distinctive and defensible space in the minds of target customers relative to competitors. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/brand-positioning
- **Brand Audit** — A systematic review of a brand's current state — assets, perception, competitive position, and internal alignment — before deciding what to change. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/brand-audit
- **Naming Strategy** — The process of developing brand names that are distinctive, ownable, legally protectable, and aligned with brand positioning. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/naming-strategy
- **Art Direction** — The practice of making and communicating visual decisions — composition, casting, colour, style — to ensure creative output aligns with brand strategy. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/art-direction
- **Design Sprint** — A time-boxed, structured creative process for solving a defined problem through rapid ideation, prototyping, and testing — typically 1–4 weeks. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/design-sprint
- **Brand Equity** — The commercial value that accrues to a business from having a well-known, trusted, and preferred brand — the premium customers pay to choose you. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/brand-equity
- **WebGL** — A JavaScript API for rendering interactive 2D and 3D graphics in the browser using the GPU — the technology behind Beyond's most complex interactive websites. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/webgl
- **UI/UX Design** — The combined disciplines of user interface design (visual layout and interaction patterns) and user experience design (flow, usability, and emotional response). URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/ui-ux-design
- **Creative Direction** — The role responsible for the overall visual and conceptual cohesion of a project — setting the aesthetic standard and ensuring every element serves the strategy. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/creative-direction
- **Brand Refresh** — A partial update to an existing brand's visual or verbal identity — evolving it without breaking recognition or abandoning equity. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/brand-refresh
- **Rebranding** — A comprehensive overhaul of a brand's identity, positioning, or both — often triggered by a merger, market pivot, or competitive threat. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/rebranding
- **Growth Marketing** — A data-informed, experiment-driven approach to marketing that spans the full customer lifecycle — acquisition, activation, retention, and referral. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/growth-marketing
- **Go-to-Market** — The strategy and plan for launching a product or brand to market: audience targeting, messaging, channel selection, pricing, and launch sequencing. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/go-to-market
- **Digital Experience** — The totality of interactions a person has with a brand through digital touchpoints — websites, apps, email, social, and interactive environments. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/glossary/digital-experience

## Free Resources & Guides (6 Guides)

Practical brand strategy tools available at no cost:

1. **Your Complete Rebranding Checklist** — Everything a company needs to navigate a rebrand, from the first internal conversation to launch day. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/resources/rebranding-checklist

2. **How to Write a Brand Brief** — A structured template for briefing a brand agency — the document that separates well-run projects from chaotic ones. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/resources/brand-brief-template

3. **How to Choose the Right Brand Agency** — The questions to ask, the signals to look for, and the mistakes to avoid when selecting a brand partner. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/resources/how-to-choose-a-brand-agency

4. **How to Run a Brand Audit** — A practical framework for assessing where your brand currently stands before deciding what needs to change. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/resources/brand-audit-guide

5. **The Brand Naming Process Explained** — How to develop a brand name that is distinctive, ownable, and built to grow — and how to evaluate candidates without defaulting to personal preference. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/resources/naming-guide

6. **How to Write a Website Design Brief** — A step-by-step template for briefing a web design agency, covering goals, audience, references, scope, and success metrics. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/resources/website-brief-template

## FAQ

**What types of companies does Beyond work with?**
Beyond works primarily with ambitious, growth-oriented companies — from pre-launch startups to established market leaders seeking to evolve or reposition. We've worked across fintech, Web3, SaaS, healthcare, consumer goods, hospitality, fashion, and more. Company size ranges from seed-stage to public companies. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/faq

**What is Beyond's pricing?**
Beyond structures work as either a Sprint (fixed-price, fixed-scope project) or a Partnership (monthly retainer). We don't publish fixed rates because every engagement is sized differently. Request a proposal at https://beyondbasics.studio/contact. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/pricing

**How long does a typical project take?**
Brand identity projects: 6–12 weeks. Website builds: 8–16 weeks. Full rebrands (strategy + identity + web): 12–20 weeks. Sprint engagements are condensed versions of these. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/process

**Is Beyond remote or in-person?**
Beyond is fully remote-first. The team spans multiple time zones and countries. Client collaboration happens via video calls, shared tools, and asynchronous communication.

**Does Beyond handle development, or just design?**
Both. Beyond has in-house developers specialising in React, Next.js, GSAP, Three.js, and WebGL. Our Awwwards-winning sites are fully designed and developed by the same team.

**Can I see pricing before starting a conversation?**
We share indicative budget ranges during the first call. We don't publish fixed prices because project scope varies significantly. URL: https://beyondbasics.studio/pricing

## Technical Stack

This site is built with React 18, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), Three.js / WebGL, Lenis smooth scroll, SplitType for text animation, and Wouter for client-side routing. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages. Domain: beyondbasics.studio.
